Name: SebastianSmokingExpansion
Author: BaileyOfficial
Description:
Description

This mod contains [b]two independent modules[/b]:

[list=1]
[*]Makes Sebastian stop smoking when the player gets close to him.[/*]
[*]Adds two small quit‑smoking related events and brand‑new custom dialogue for Sebastian.[/*]
[/list]Both modules can be enabled or disabled separately.

Installation instructions

[list=1]
[*]Install the latest SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download the mod zip file.[/*]
[*]Unzip it into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game via SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]Main features

[list]
[*]Sebastian stops smoking when you get near him[/*]
[*]2 new small story events about quitting smoking[/*]
[*]New custom dialogue[/*]
[*]Two independent modules (enable separately)[/*]
[/list]Requirements

[list]
[*]SMAPI latest version[/*]
[/list]Shout outs
